usedFor: Swit holds chat and projects, and Microsoft Excel logs messages with “Add Row To Table” after “New Message Arrives”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Arrives” in Swit, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each message in the chosen channel becomes a table row, a log you can search.

watchOut: “New Message Arrives” is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
